kicad_happy_schematic_help.stdout:
usage: analyze_schematic.py [-h] [--output OUTPUT] [--compact] [--schema]
                            [--config CONFIG] [--project-root PROJECT_ROOT]
                            [--no-hierarchy] [--lifecycle]
                            [--analysis-dir ANALYSIS_DIR] [--text]
                            [--stage {schematic,layout,pre_fab,bring_up}]
                            [--audience {designer,reviewer,manager}]
                            [--only-deterministic]
                            [schematic]

KiCad Schematic Analyzer

positional arguments:
  schematic             Path to .kicad_sch, .kicad_pro, or project directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
                        Output JSON file (default: stdout)
  --compact             Compact JSON output
  --schema              Print JSON output schema and exit
  --config CONFIG       Path to .kicad-happy.json project config file
  --project-root PROJECT_ROOT
                        Root .kicad_sch for hierarchy context (auto-discovered
                        if omitted)
  --no-hierarchy        Disable hierarchy auto-discovery (treat file as
                        standalone root)
  --lifecycle           Run lifecycle/obsolescence audit (requires network +
                        API keys)
  --analysis-dir ANALYSIS_DIR
                        Write output to analysis cache directory (timestamped
                        runs)
  --text                Print human-readable text report to stdout
  --stage {schematic,layout,pre_fab,bring_up}
                        Filter findings by review stage
  --audience {designer,reviewer,manager}
                        Audience level for summaries and --text output
  --only-deterministic  Accepted for consistency; analyzers never write llm_*
                        fields. Honored by downstream consumers (Phase 4 spec
                        §3.4).
